newsitem.title: UK: Austrian trade seeks free market barley, wheat.
newsitem.headline: Austrian trade seeks free market barley, wheat.

text.p: Austrian grain traders have bid for 10,000 tonnes of open market barley and 1,000 tonnes of open market wheat at Thursday's EU export tender, member state officials said.
Bids for barley are at refunds ranging from 28.05 Ecus to 30.95 Ecus, they said. Bids for wheat are around 19 Ecus.
There is no intervention grain available in Austria, so there are no intervention bids, they said.
The EU's tender will be adjudicated by the weekly cereals management committee at its meeting Thursday afternoon.
